records.source: Hello, you've reached Marnie's Ranch. My business hours are from 9AM to 4PM. Please come visit me then. *beep*
records.translation: Hello, nakatawag ka sa Rantso ni Marnie. Bukas ang tindahan ko mula 9AM hanggang 4PM. Dalawin mo ako sa mga oras na iyon. *beep*

records.source: Hello, you've reached Marnie's Ranch. My shop is closed today.
records.translation: Hello, nakatawag ka sa Rantso ni Marnie. Sarado ang tindahan ko ngayon.

records.source: Check livestock prices
records.translation: Tingnan ang halaga ng mga alagang hayop

records.source: Hello?#$b#Um... Uhhh... This is Vincent.$3#$b#... $3#$b#Um... Do you have any piggies on your farm?$h#$b#...$3#$b#Okay I gotta go! *click* $3
records.translation: Hello?#$b#Um... Uhhh... Si Vincent ito.$3#$b#... $3#$b#Um... May mga biik ka ba sa bukid mo?$h#$b#...$3#$b#Sige, aalis na ako! *click* $3

records.source: You hear a robotic voice on the other end. # Congratulations. . . You. Have. A. 10,000g. JOJA. Rebate. Waiting. For. You. . . Please. Mail. Your. Credit. Card. Number. To. 133. N. Gunger St. Zuzu. City. To. Receive. Your. Rebate. . . *CLICK*
records.translation: May naririnig kang robotikong tinig sa kabilang dulo. # Binabati. Ka. Namin. May. 10,000g. Kang. Balik-Bayad. Mula. Sa. JOJA. . . Pakipadala. Ang. Numero. Ng. Credit. Card. Mo. Sa. 133. N. Gunger St. Lungsod. Ng. Zuzu. Upang. Matanggap. Ang. Balik-Bayad. Mo. . . *CLICK*

records.source: Hey, @. It's me, Pierre. #$b#How are you doing? Good? That's good.#$b#Well, I just wanted to say that I appreciate your business. And I'd like to remind you that Pierre's General Store carries *the finest* seeds and produce anywhere.#$b#I hope to see you in the store very soon. Bye! *click*
records.translation: Hoy, @. Ako ito, si Pierre. #$b#Kumusta ka? Mabuti? Mabuti naman.#$b#Buweno, gusto ko lang sabihing pinahahalagahan ko ang pagtangkilik mo. At gusto kong ipaalala sa iyo na ang Tindahang Panlahat ni Pierre ang may *pinakamainam* na binhi at ani saanman.#$b#Sana ay makita kita sa tindahan sa lalong madaling panahon. Paalam! *click*

records.source: You hear a squeaky voice on the other end: # Heyo poke! Me sell gud hats. Please come, n' bring coines, poke. Me like coines. *click*
records.translation: May naririnig kang matinis na tinig sa kabilang dulo: # Helo poki! Ako benta ganda sombrero. Punta ka, dala barya, poki. Ako gusto barya. *click*

records.source: It's a pre-recorded message in a foreign language. You can't understand it at all.
records.translation: Isa itong naka-record na mensahe sa banyagang wika. Wala ka talagang maintindihan.

records.source: *sniff* *sniff*$2#$b#HoOoOoOoOoO!$3#$b#... Is that you? #$b# *grunt*... I have some of that good sauce still, friend.#$b#It's making me very, very happy. *snort*$1#$b#Just want to thank you... bye bye friend. *click*
records.translation: *singhot* *singhot*$2#$b#HoOoOoOoOoO!$3#$b#... Ikaw ba iyan? #$b# *ungol*... May natitira pa akong kaunti sa masarap na sarsang iyon, kaibigan.#$b#Labis, labis akong napasasaya nito. *singhal*$1#$b#Gusto ko lang magpasalamat... paalam, kaibigan. *click*

records.source: Hey, @. #$b#I just wanted to check up on you and see if %farm Farm is doing well.#$b#$y 'How's everything going?_Good! I really feel at home here._Good to hear. *I think I can speak for everyone in saying that we really value your presence in the community.*Your Grandfather would be really proud of what you've accomplished. *Well, I'll let you get back to your work. Goodbye!_Good! The farm is very productive._Good to hear! *Your farm has really boosted the local economy, which is good for everyone. We all appreciate your hard work! *I think it's safe to say that your Grandfather would be really proud of what you've accomplished.*Well, I'll let you get back to your work. Goodbye!_Not so good..._Oh... I'm sorry to hear that. $s*Uh... Keep working hard and I'm sure things will improve... *Well... I'll let you get back to it, then... Okay? Talk to you later. Bye. $s_I know your secret, Lewis._What's that? I think the line cut out... I can't hear a thing. Alright, well I guess I'll hang up then. Bye.$3'
records.translation: Hoy, @. #$b#Gusto ko lang kumustahin ka at tingnan kung maayos ang %farm Farm.#$b#$y 'Kumusta ang lahat?_Mabuti! Talagang pakiramdam ko ay tahanan ko na ito._Ikinagagalak kong marinig iyan. *Sa tingin ko ay makapagsasalita ako para sa lahat kapag sinabi kong lubos naming pinahahalagahan ang presensiya mo sa komunidad.*Talagang ipagmamalaki ng Lolo mo ang mga nagawa mo. *Buweno, hahayaan na kitang bumalik sa trabaho mo. Paalam!_Mabuti! Napakamasagana ng bukid._Ikinagagalak kong marinig iyan! *Lubos na napasigla ng bukid mo ang lokal na ekonomiya, na mabuti para sa lahat. Pinahahalagahan naming lahat ang sipag mo! *Masasabi kong tiyak na ipagmamalaki ng Lolo mo ang mga nagawa mo.*Buweno, hahayaan na kitang bumalik sa trabaho mo. Paalam!_Hindi gaanong mabuti..._O... Ikinalulungkot kong marinig iyan. $s*Uh... Patuloy kang magsikap at sigurado akong bubuti ang mga bagay... *Buweno... hahayaan na kitang bumalik doon... Ayos? Mag-usap tayo mamaya. Paalam. $s_Alam ko ang lihim mo, Lewis._Ano iyon? Parang naputol ang linya... Wala akong marinig. Sige, ibababa ko na lang. Paalam.$3'
records.englishResidueReason: The literal “Farm” is part of the protected %farm Farm runtime substitution form and must remain unchanged.

records.source: You place the receiver to your ear, and are met with a roiling, abrasive static. # But wait... beneath it all, you can make out something else... an otherworldly voice... # 'Y-O-U H-A-V-E F-O-R-S-A-K-E-N U-S'
records.translation: Idinikit mo ang telepono sa tainga mo at sinalubong ka ng magulo at nakagagasgas na ugong. # Ngunit sandali... sa ilalim ng lahat ng iyon, may iba ka pang naririnig... isang tinig na hindi mula sa mundong ito... # 'T-I-N-A-L-I-K-U-R-A-N M-O K-A-M-I'

records.source: Hey... I was just thinking about that time, back on the island... Do you remember?
records.translation: Hoy... Iniisip ko lang ang panahong iyon, noong nasa isla tayo... Naaalala mo ba?

records.source: Remind me
records.translation: Ipaalala mo sa akin

records.source: I'm busy
records.translation: Abala ako

records.source: When we talked about your home?
records.translation: Noong pinag-usapan natin ang tahanan mo?

records.source: When we talked about birds?
records.translation: Noong pinag-usapan natin ang mga ibon?

records.source: When I decided to move?
records.translation: Noong nagpasya akong lumipat?

records.source: Oh, wow! It's my old stock list! I've been searching everywhere for this thing.$h#$b#Let me see... yup! It's all still here.#$b#With these order codes, I can expand my stock to include seeds from all seasons, year round!#$b#Thanks so much for bringing this back to me, @.$h
records.translation: O, wow! Ang luma kong listahan ng paninda! Hinahanap ko ito kung saan-saan.$h#$b#Tingnan ko... oo! Narito pa rin ang lahat.#$b#Gamit ang mga code sa pag-order na ito, mapalalawak ko ang paninda ko upang maisama ang mga binhi mula sa lahat ng panahon, buong taon!#$b#Maraming salamat sa pagbabalik nito sa akin, @.$h

records.source: Marlon speaking... Did you lose something in the mines again? Yes, yes... I'm willing to fetch it... for a price.
records.translation: Si Marlon ito... May nawala ka na naman ba sa mga minahan? Oo, oo... Handa akong kunin iyon... kapalit ng bayad.

records.source: Hello?... Yep, I'm going to fetch your item tonight. You can relax. No need to keep calling! *click*
records.translation: Hello?... Oo, kukunin ko ang bagay mo mamayang gabi. Maaari ka nang magrelaks. Hindi mo na kailangang tumawag nang tumawag! *click*

records.source: What's that? You haven't lost anything in the mines? Okay. Sounds like you don't need my help, then. Take care. *click*
records.translation: Ano iyon? Wala ka namang nawala sa mga minahan? Sige. Mukhang hindi mo kailangan ang tulong ko. Ingat. *click*
